231	        stopButton.isEnabled = false
232	        detailLabel.stringValue = "Stopping…"
233	        token.cancel()
234	    }
235	
236	    @objc private func revealClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
237	        guard didFinish else { return }
238	        NSWorkspace.shared.activateFileViewerSelecting([plan.directory])
239	        dismiss(self)
240	    }
241	}
242	import AppKit
243	
244	/// File ▸ Consolidate Media… — copies every file the project references into
245	/// `media/` inside the `.framejob` package and relinks the project at the
246	/// copies (spec §5.6, road map Phase 6).
247	///
248	/// Frame Job REFERENCES media by default (§4.2, §11): a project is a small
249	/// JSON file pointing at whatever the footage happens to live on. Consolidate
250	/// is the one command that trades that for self-containment — the package
251	/// becomes the whole edit, so it can be handed to someone else or archived
252	/// with its sources deleted.
253	///
254	/// This type is the engine and nothing else: it plans, it copies, and it
255	/// hands back the `relink_media` ops it earned. Applying them is the
256	/// caller's job — `EditorViewController+Consolidate.swift` through
257	/// `ProjectDocument`, `AgentServer+Media.swift` through `editResult` — so
258	/// there is still exactly one mutation point.
259	///
260	/// **Four traps, all of them load-bearing.**
261	///
262	/// 1. *An untitled project has no package to copy into.* `plan` refuses it
263	///    rather than inventing a destination: `ProjectDocument`'s temporary
264	///    cache directory is documented as orphanable, and orphaning a cache
265	///    costs a filmstrip where orphaning MEDIA loses the file.
266	/// 2. *Two files can share a basename.* Names are claimed against the
267	///    directory's existing contents and against each other, case-insensitively
268	///    (the volume usually is), so `intro.mov` and `b-roll/intro.mov` become
269	///    `intro.mov` and `intro-2.mov`.
270	/// 3. *A file already inside the package must not be copied onto itself.*
271	///    Those entries are relinked but never copied — and relinking them still
272	///    matters, because a stale BOOKMARK pointing outside the package wins
273	///    over the path in `mediaURL(for:)`.
274	/// 4. *A failure part-way through must leave the project openable.* Nothing
275	///    is relinked until its copy is on disk, so a run that dies half way
276	///    leaves half the media consolidated and the rest still pointing at the
277	///    originals — every clip still resolves. Cancelling is the same story
278	///    with a friendlier name.
279	///
280	/// **Bookmarks are deliberately cleared** for a consolidated entry. NSDocument
281	/// writes a package by building a new one beside the old and swapping it in,
282	/// so a `URL.bookmarkData()` made for a file INSIDE the package is a bookmark
283	/// to a file a later save may replace; the path — which `ProjectDocument`
284	/// re-anchors to the package on open — is the durable half.
285	///
286	/// **A recording's cursor file is a second copy** (road map creator-jobs CU5,
287	/// spec §11 CU-51): planned after its movie, named for the movie's
288	/// destination stem by the same claimed-name rule, copied only once its
289	/// movie's copy has landed, and recorded by `set_media_cursor` only once its
290	/// own copy has. A failed cursor copy leaves the media's cursor at the
291	/// original, which still resolves; Consolidate's `relink_media` ops carry no
292	/// probe, so they keep `media.cursor` (CU-39). A media whose movie is
293	/// missing is left alone, its cursor file included.
294	enum MediaConsolidator {
295	
296	    /// One file to bring inside. `source` has already been resolved through
297	    /// `mediaURL(for:)`, so it exists at plan time.
298	    struct Copy {
299	        let media: UInt32
300	        let name: String
301	        let source: URL
302	        let destination: URL
303	        let bytes: Int64
304	    }
305	
306	    /// One cursor file to bring inside (CU-51). `movie` is the movie copy
307	    /// that must land in this run before this one may be copied — nil when
308	    /// the movie is already inside the package.
309	    struct CursorCopy {
310	        let media: UInt32
311	        let name: String
312	        let source: URL
313	        let destination: URL
314	        let bytes: Int64
315	        let inPicture: Bool
316	        let movie: URL?
317	    }
318	
319	    /// What a run will do, computed before anything is touched.
320	    struct Plan {
321	        /// `<package>/media`, which may not exist yet.
322	        let directory: URL
323	        let copies: [Copy]
324	        /// Media already inside `media/` that needs only its link corrected
325	        /// — a stale bookmark, or a path spelled differently from the file.
326	        /// Its destination is on disk before the run starts.
327	        let relinks: [Copy]
328	        /// The second and later rows of two media entries that resolve to
329	        /// ONE file: they are relinked at another row's copy rather than
330	        /// copying the footage twice, so their op waits until that copy has
331	        /// really landed.
332	        let aliases: [Copy]
333	        /// Names of media with no file anywhere. Consolidate cannot copy
334	        /// what it cannot find; Relink… is the fix and the report says so.
335	        let missing: [String]
336	        let bytes: Int64
337	        /// The cursor files' own three lists, `copies`', `relinks`' and
338	        /// `aliases`' meanings (CU-51); their bytes are in `bytes`.
339	        var cursorCopies: [CursorCopy] = []
340	        var cursorRelinks: [CursorCopy] = []
341	        var cursorAliases: [CursorCopy] = []
342	        /// The names of cursor files that resolve to nothing; left alone.
343	        var missingCursors: [String] = []
344	
345	        /// True when there is nothing to do — every file is already inside
346	        /// the package and correctly linked.
347	        var isEmpty: Bool {
348	            copies.isEmpty && relinks.isEmpty && aliases.isEmpty && cursorCopies.isEmpty
349	                && cursorRelinks.isEmpty && cursorAliases.isEmpty
350	        }
351	    }
352	
353	    /// What a run actually did.
354	    struct Outcome {
355	        let ops: [ReelOp]
356	        let copied: Int
357	        let bytes: Int64
358	        let missing: [String]
359	        /// One line per file that could not be copied, with the reason.
360	        let failures: [String]
361	        let cancelled: Bool
362	        /// The plan's `missingCursors`, reported (CU-51).
363	        var missingCursors: [String] = []
364	
365	        /// The sentence the sheet and the agent both report.
366	        var summary: String {
367	            var parts: [String] = []
368	            parts.append(
369	                copied == 0
370	                    ? "No files needed copying." : "Copied \(copied) file\(copied == 1 ? "" : "s")"
371	                        + " (\(ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: bytes, countStyle: .file)))"
372	                        + " into the package.")
373	            if cancelled { parts.append("Stopped before the rest.") }
374	            if !failures.isEmpty {
375	                parts.append(
376	                    "\(failures.count) file\(failures.count == 1 ? "" : "s") could not be copied.")
377	            }
378	            if !missing.isEmpty {
379	                parts.append(
380	                    "\(missing.count) missing file\(missing.count == 1 ? "" : "s") "
381	                        + "\(missing.count == 1 ? "was" : "were") left alone — relink "
382	                        + missing.prefix(3).joined(separator: ", ")
383	                        + (missing.count > 3 ? ", …" : "") + ".")
384	            }
385	            if !missingCursors.isEmpty {
386	                let one = missingCursors.count == 1
387	                parts.append(
388	                    "\(missingCursors.count) cursor file\(one ? " was" : "s were") missing and "
389	                        + "left alone.")
390	            }
391	            return parts.joined(separator: " ")
392	        }
393	    }
394	
395	    enum ConsolidateError: LocalizedError {
396	        case untitled
397	        case noMedia
398	        case unwritable(URL, String)
399	
400	        var errorDescription: String? {
401	            switch self {
402	            case .untitled:
403	                return "Save the project first — Consolidate Media copies files into the "
404	                    + ".framejob package, and a project that has never been saved does not have "
405	                    + "one yet."
406	            case .noMedia:
407	                return "This project references no media files."
408	            case .unwritable(let url, let reason):
409	                return "“\(url.lastPathComponent)” could not be created: \(reason)"
410	            }
411	        }
412	    }
413	
414	    /// A cancel flag the sheet sets on the main thread and the copy loop
415	    /// reads on its own queue. An `NSLock` rather than a plain `Bool`
416	    /// because that is a data race, and rather than a queue hop because the
417	    /// loop has to ask between every file.
418	    final class CancelToken {
419	        private let lock = NSLock()
420	        private var flag = false
421	
422	        var isCancelled: Bool {
423	            lock.lock()
424	            defer { lock.unlock() }
425	            return flag
426	        }
427	
428	        func cancel() {
429	            lock.lock()
430	            flag = true
431	            lock.unlock()
432	        }
433	    }
434	
435	    // MARK: - Planning
436	
437	    /// Everything the run will do, decided on the main thread against the
438	    /// document's current snapshot — so the copy loop, which runs on another
439	    /// queue, never reads the model.
440	    static func plan(for document: ProjectDocument) throws -> Plan {
441	        guard let directory = document.mediaDirectory else { throw ConsolidateError.untitled }
442	        let media = document.project.snapshot.media
443	        guard !media.isEmpty else { throw ConsolidateError.noMedia }
444	
445	        // Names already spoken for by an earlier consolidate. Lower-cased
446	        // because the volume under a package is usually case-insensitive,
447	        // and "Intro.mov" landing on "intro.mov" would be a lost file.
448	        var claimed = Set(
449	            ((try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path)) ?? [])
450	                .map { $0.lowercased() })
451	        // Two media entries can resolve to ONE file (different rows, the
452	        // same footage). The first row earns the copy; the rest are relinked
453	        // at it, so the package holds the footage once.
454	        var bySource: [String: URL] = [:]
455	
456	        var copies: [Copy] = []
457	        var relinks: [Copy] = []
458	        var aliases: [Copy] = []
459	        var missing: [String] = []
460	        var bytes: Int64 = 0
461	        var cursors = CursorPlan()
462	        for entry in media {
463	            guard let url = mediaURL(for: entry)?.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardizedFileURL
464	            else {
465	                missing.append(entry.name)
466	                continue
467	            }
468	            // Where the movie will be once the run is done, and the copy that
469	            // must land first for its cursor file (CU-51).
470	            let movieAt: URL
471	            let movieCopy: URL?
472	            if isInside(url, directory) {
473	                movieAt = url
474	                movieCopy = nil
475	                // Already consolidated. It still needs an op when a stale
476	                // bookmark or a differently-spelled path could send
477	                // `mediaURL(for:)` back outside the package.
478	                if entry.bookmark != nil || entry.path != url.path {
479	                    relinks.append(
480	                        Copy(
481	                            media: entry.id, name: url.lastPathComponent, source: url,
482	                            destination: url, bytes: 0))
483	                }
484	            } else if let shared = bySource[url.path] {
485	                movieAt = shared
486	                movieCopy = shared
487	                aliases.append(
488	                    Copy(
489	                        media: entry.id, name: shared.lastPathComponent, source: url,
490	                        destination: shared, bytes: 0))
491	            } else {
492	                let destination = directory.appendingPathComponent(
493	                    uniqueName(for: url, claimed: &claimed))
494	                bySource[url.path] = destination
495	                let size = fileSize(url)
496	                bytes += size
497	                copies.append(
498	                    Copy(
499	                        media: entry.id, name: destination.lastPathComponent, source: url,
500	                        destination: destination, bytes: size))
501	                movieAt = destination
502	                movieCopy = destination
503	            }
504	            bytes += planCursor(
505	                entry, movieAt: movieAt, movieCopy: movieCopy, directory: directory,
506	                claimed: &claimed, into: &cursors)
507	        }
508	        return Plan(
509	            directory: directory, copies: copies, relinks: relinks, aliases: aliases,
510	            missing: missing, bytes: bytes, cursorCopies: cursors.copies,
511	            cursorRelinks: cursors.relinks, cursorAliases: cursors.aliases,
512	            missingCursors: cursors.missing)
513	    }
514	
515	    /// The cursor lists as `plan` builds them, and the copies by resolved
516	    /// source path, so two media naming one file share one copy.
517	    private struct CursorPlan {
518	        var copies: [CursorCopy] = []
519	        var relinks: [CursorCopy] = []
520	        var aliases: [CursorCopy] = []
521	        var missing: [String] = []
522	        var bySource: [String: URL] = [:]
523	    }
524	
525	    /// Plans `entry`'s cursor file, if it has one, after its movie (CU-51):
526	    /// a file that resolves to nothing is missing; one already inside
527	    /// `media/` is relinked only when its bookmark or spelling could lead
528	    /// out; one another media's cursor already copies is an alias; anything
529	    /// else is a copy named `<the movie's stem>.fjcursor` by the claimed-name
530	    /// rule. Answers the bytes it adds to the plan.
531	    private static func planCursor(
532	        _ entry: MediaSnapshot, movieAt: URL, movieCopy: URL?, directory: URL,
533	        claimed: inout Set<String>, into cursors: inout CursorPlan
534	    ) -> Int64 {
535	        guard let cursor = entry.cursor, let file = cursorURL(for: entry) else { return 0 }
536	        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: file.path) else {
537	            cursors.missing.append(file.lastPathComponent)
538	            return 0
539	        }
540	        let url = file.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardizedFileURL
541	        if isInside(url, directory) {
542	            if cursor.bookmark != nil || cursor.path != url.path {
543	                cursors.relinks.append(
544	                    CursorCopy(
545	                        media: entry.id, name: url.lastPathComponent, source: url,
546	                        destination: url, bytes: 0, inPicture: cursor.inPicture, movie: nil))
547	            }
548	            return 0
549	        }
550	        if let shared = cursors.bySource[url.path] {
551	            cursors.aliases.append(
552	                CursorCopy(
553	                    media: entry.id, name: shared.lastPathComponent, source: url,
554	                    destination: shared, bytes: 0, inPicture: cursor.inPicture, movie: movieCopy))
555	            return 0
556	        }
557	        let named = CursorFileWriter.url(forMovie: movieAt)
558	        let destination = directory.appendingPathComponent(
559	            uniqueName(for: named, claimed: &claimed))
560	        cursors.bySource[url.path] = destination
561	        let size = fileSize(url)
562	        cursors.copies.append(
563	            CursorCopy(
564	                media: entry.id, name: destination.lastPathComponent, source: url,
565	                destination: destination, bytes: size, inPicture: cursor.inPicture,
566	                movie: movieCopy))
567	        return size
568	    }
569	
570	    private static func fileSize(_ url: URL) -> Int64 {
571	        Int64((try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.fileSizeKey]))?.fileSize ?? 0)
572	    }
573	
574	    /// Whether `url` already lives in the package's `media/` directory —
575	    /// both sides standardized, so `/tmp` and `/private/tmp` spellings of
576	    /// the same path agree.
577	    private static func isInside(_ url: URL, _ directory: URL) -> Bool {
578	        let root = directory.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardizedFileURL.path
579	        return url.path.hasPrefix(root.hasSuffix("/") ? root : root + "/")
580	    }
581	
582	    /// A file name nothing else in the directory has taken. Path separators
583	    /// cannot appear in a `lastPathComponent`, but a colon can (it is a
584	    /// separator in the Finder's own spelling), so it goes too.
585	    private static func uniqueName(for source: URL, claimed: inout Set<String>) -> String {
586	        let raw = source.lastPathComponent.replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "-")
587	            .replacingOccurrences(of: ":", with: "-")
588	        let base = raw.isEmpty ? "media" : raw
589	        let stem = (base as NSString).deletingPathExtension
590	        let ext = (base as NSString).pathExtension
591	        var candidate = base
592	        var suffix = 2
593	        while claimed.contains(candidate.lowercased()) {
594	            let root = stem.isEmpty ? "media" : stem
595	            candidate = ext.isEmpty ? "\(root)-\(suffix)" : "\(root)-\(suffix).\(ext)"
596	            suffix += 1
597	        }
598	        claimed.insert(candidate.lowercased())
599	        return candidate
600	    }
601	
602	    // MARK: - Running
603	
604	    /// Copies the planned files and returns the ops that record where they
605	    /// went. **Blocking** — the UI path calls it on a background queue with
606	    /// a progress sheet up (the one `DispatchQueue` seam this feature adds),
607	    /// the agent calls it inline.
608	    ///
609	    /// `progress` is called with a 0…1 fraction and the file being copied,
610	    /// on whatever thread this runs on; the sheet hops to main itself.
611	    ///
612	    /// An op is emitted only for a file that is really on disk, which is the
613	    /// whole of the "a failure part-way through leaves the project openable"
614	    /// promise.
615	    static func run(
616	        _ plan: Plan, cancel: CancelToken? = nil,
617	        progress: ((Double, String) -> Void)? = nil
618	    ) -> Outcome {
619	        var ops: [ReelOp] = []
620	        var failures: [String] = []
621	        var copied = 0
622	        var written: Int64 = 0
623	
624	        // The entries whose file is already inside cost nothing and go
625	        // first, so even a cancelled run leaves the package tidier.
626	        for entry in plan.relinks {
627	            ops.append(.relinkMedia(media: entry.media, path: entry.destination.path))
628	        }
629	        for entry in plan.cursorRelinks {
630	            ops.append(cursorOp(entry))
631	        }
632	
633	        let manager = FileManager.default
634	        do {
635	            try manager.createDirectory(at: plan.directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
636	        } catch {
637	            return Outcome(
638	                ops: ops, copied: 0, bytes: 0, missing: plan.missing,
639	                failures: [plan.directory.lastPathComponent + " — " + error.localizedDescription],
640	                cancelled: false, missingCursors: plan.missingCursors)
641	        }
642	
643	        var cancelled = false
644	        // The movie copies that really landed, which a cursor copy waits on.
645	        var landed = Set<String>()
646	        for entry in plan.copies {
647	            if cancel?.isCancelled == true {
648	                cancelled = true
649	                break
650	            }
651	            progress?(plan.bytes > 0 ? Double(written) / Double(plan.bytes) : 0, entry.name)
652	            do {
653	                // A destination left behind by an interrupted run holds a
654	                // half-written file AND its name; removing it first is what
655	                // makes a second Consolidate finish the job instead of
656	                // making a duplicate beside the stub.
657	                if manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path) {
658	                    try manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
659	                }
660	                try manager.copyItem(at: entry.source, to: entry.destination)
661	                ops.append(.relinkMedia(media: entry.media, path: entry.destination.path))
662	                landed.insert(entry.destination.path)
663	                copied += 1
664	                written += entry.bytes
665	            } catch {
666	                failures.append(entry.name + " — " + error.localizedDescription)
667	                try? manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
668	            }
669	        }
670	        // An alias points at another row's copy, so it may only be recorded
671	        // once that copy is really on disk — a failed or skipped copy leaves
672	        // both rows pointing at the original file, which still opens.
673	        for entry in plan.aliases where manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path) {
674	            ops.append(.relinkMedia(media: entry.media, path: entry.destination.path))
675	        }
676	        // The cursor files, each after its movie (CU-51): copied only once
677	        // that movie's copy landed, recorded only once its own copy did.
678	        for entry in plan.cursorCopies where !cancelled {
679	            if cancel?.isCancelled == true {
680	                cancelled = true
681	                break
682	            }
683	            guard entry.movie.map({ landed.contains($0.path) }) ?? true else { continue }
684	            progress?(plan.bytes > 0 ? Double(written) / Double(plan.bytes) : 0, entry.name)
685	            do {
686	                if manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path) {
687	                    try manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
688	                }
689	                try manager.copyItem(at: entry.source, to: entry.destination)
690	                ops.append(cursorOp(entry))
691	                copied += 1
692	                written += entry.bytes
693	            } catch {
694	                failures.append(entry.name + " — " + error.localizedDescription)
695	                try? manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
696	            }
697	        }
698	        for entry in plan.cursorAliases
699	        where manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path)
700	            && (entry.movie.map({ landed.contains($0.path) }) ?? true)
701	        {
702	            ops.append(cursorOp(entry))
703	        }
704	        progress?(1, "")
705	        return Outcome(
706	            ops: ops, copied: copied, bytes: written, missing: plan.missing, failures: failures,
707	            cancelled: cancelled, missingCursors: plan.missingCursors)
708	    }
709	
710	    /// `set_media_cursor` at the copy, with no bookmark: a bookmark to a file
711	    /// inside the package is one a later save may replace.
712	    private static func cursorOp(_ entry: CursorCopy) -> ReelOp {
713	        .setMediaCursor(
714	            media: entry.media,
715	            cursor: MediaCursor(path: entry.destination.path, inPicture: entry.inPicture))
716	    }
717	}

1	import AppKit
2	
3	/// File ▸ Consolidate Media… — the menu half of `MediaConsolidator`, which
4	/// owns the plan and the copying (and documents the four traps this command
5	/// walks around).
6	///
7	/// The shape is the export's: decide everything up front, put a sheet up, do
8	/// the work on another queue, and commit through `ProjectDocument` when it is
9	/// over. Every editor action validates false while a sheet is attached
10	/// (`EditorViewController.validateUserInterfaceItem`), which is what lets the
11	/// sheet trust the plan it was handed — the model cannot change under it.
12	extension EditorViewController {
13	
14	    /// The menu item. An untitled project has no package to copy into, so
15	    /// instead of the greyed-out item that would leave the user guessing,
16	    /// this says so and offers the Save that fixes it.
17	    func consolidateMediaCommand() {
18	        guard let document = document, let window = view.window else {
19	            NSSound.beep()
20	            return
21	        }
22	        guard document.fileURL != nil else {
23	            offerSaveBeforeConsolidating(document, in: window)
24	            return
25	        }
26	        beginConsolidate(document, in: window)
27	    }
28	
29	    private func offerSaveBeforeConsolidating(_ document: ProjectDocument, in window: NSWindow) {
30	        let alert = NSAlert()
31	        alert.alertStyle = .informational
32	        alert.messageText = "Save this project first?"
33	        alert.informativeText =
34	            MediaConsolidator.ConsolidateError.untitled.localizedDescription

244	/// File ▸ Consolidate Media… — copies every file the project references into
245	/// `media/` inside the `.framejob` package and relinks the project at the
246	/// copies (spec §5.6, road map Phase 6).
247	///
248	/// Frame Job REFERENCES media by default (§4.2, §11): a project is a small
249	/// JSON file pointing at whatever the footage happens to live on. Consolidate
250	/// is the one command that trades that for self-containment — the package
251	/// becomes the whole edit, so it can be handed to someone else or archived
252	/// with its sources deleted.
253	///
254	/// This type is the engine and nothing else: it plans, it copies, and it
255	/// hands back the `relink_media` ops it earned. Applying them is the
256	/// caller's job — `EditorViewController+Consolidate.swift` through
257	/// `ProjectDocument`, `AgentServer+Media.swift` through `editResult` — so
258	/// there is still exactly one mutation point.
259	///
260	/// **Four traps, all of them load-bearing.**
261	///
262	/// 1. *An untitled project has no package to copy into.* `plan` refuses it
263	///    rather than inventing a destination: `ProjectDocument`'s temporary
264	///    cache directory is documented as orphanable, and orphaning a cache
265	///    costs a filmstrip where orphaning MEDIA loses the file.
266	/// 2. *Two files can share a basename.* Names are claimed against the
267	///    directory's existing contents and against each other, case-insensitively
268	///    (the volume usually is), so `intro.mov` and `b-roll/intro.mov` become
269	///    `intro.mov` and `intro-2.mov`.
270	/// 3. *A file already inside the package must not be copied onto itself.*
271	///    Those entries are relinked but never copied — and relinking them still
272	///    matters, because a stale BOOKMARK pointing outside the package wins
273	///    over the path in `mediaURL(for:)`.
274	/// 4. *A failure part-way through must leave the project openable.* Nothing
275	///    is relinked until its copy is on disk, so a run that dies half way
276	///    leaves half the media consolidated and the rest still pointing at the
277	///    originals — every clip still resolves. Cancelling is the same story
278	///    with a friendlier name.
279	///
280	/// **Bookmarks are deliberately cleared** for a consolidated entry. NSDocument
281	/// writes a package by building a new one beside the old and swapping it in,
282	/// so a `URL.bookmarkData()` made for a file INSIDE the package is a bookmark
283	/// to a file a later save may replace; the path — which `ProjectDocument`
284	/// re-anchors to the package on open — is the durable half.
285	///
286	/// **A recording's cursor file is a second copy** (road map creator-jobs CU5,
287	/// spec §11 CU-51): planned after its movie, named for the movie's
288	/// destination stem by the same claimed-name rule, copied only once its
289	/// movie's copy has landed, and recorded by `set_media_cursor` only once its
290	/// own copy has. A failed cursor copy leaves the media's cursor at the
291	/// original, which still resolves; Consolidate's `relink_media` ops carry no
292	/// probe, so they keep `media.cursor` (CU-39). A media whose movie is
293	/// missing is left alone, its cursor file included.
294	enum MediaConsolidator {
295	
296	    /// One file to bring inside. `source` has already been resolved through
297	    /// `mediaURL(for:)`, so it exists at plan time.
298	    struct Copy {
299	        let media: UInt32
300	        let name: String
301	        let source: URL
302	        let destination: URL
303	        let bytes: Int64
304	    }
305	
306	    /// One cursor file to bring inside (CU-51). `movie` is the movie copy
307	    /// that must land in this run before this one may be copied — nil when
308	    /// the movie is already inside the package.
309	    struct CursorCopy {
310	        let media: UInt32
311	        let name: String
312	        let source: URL
313	        let destination: URL
314	        let bytes: Int64
315	        let inPicture: Bool
316	        let movie: URL?
317	    }
318	
319	    /// What a run will do, computed before anything is touched.
320	    struct Plan {
321	        /// `<package>/media`, which may not exist yet.
322	        let directory: URL
323	        let copies: [Copy]
324	        /// Media already inside `media/` that needs only its link corrected
325	        /// — a stale bookmark, or a path spelled differently from the file.
326	        /// Its destination is on disk before the run starts.
327	        let relinks: [Copy]
328	        /// The second and later rows of two media entries that resolve to
329	        /// ONE file: they are relinked at another row's copy rather than
330	        /// copying the footage twice, so their op waits until that copy has
331	        /// really landed.
332	        let aliases: [Copy]
333	        /// Names of media with no file anywhere. Consolidate cannot copy
334	        /// what it cannot find; Relink… is the fix and the report says so.
335	        let missing: [String]
336	        let bytes: Int64
337	        /// The cursor files' own three lists, `copies`', `relinks`' and
338	        /// `aliases`' meanings (CU-51); their bytes are in `bytes`.
339	        var cursorCopies: [CursorCopy] = []
340	        var cursorRelinks: [CursorCopy] = []
341	        var cursorAliases: [CursorCopy] = []
342	        /// The names of cursor files that resolve to nothing; left alone.
343	        var missingCursors: [String] = []
344	
345	        /// True when there is nothing to do — every file is already inside
346	        /// the package and correctly linked.
347	        var isEmpty: Bool {
348	            copies.isEmpty && relinks.isEmpty && aliases.isEmpty && cursorCopies.isEmpty
349	                && cursorRelinks.isEmpty && cursorAliases.isEmpty
350	        }
351	    }
352	
353	    /// What a run actually did.
354	    struct Outcome {
355	        let ops: [ReelOp]
356	        let copied: Int
357	        let bytes: Int64
358	        let missing: [String]
359	        /// One line per file that could not be copied, with the reason.
360	        let failures: [String]
361	        let cancelled: Bool
362	        /// The plan's `missingCursors`, reported (CU-51).
363	        var missingCursors: [String] = []
364	
365	        /// The sentence the sheet and the agent both report.
366	        var summary: String {
367	            var parts: [String] = []
368	            parts.append(
369	                copied == 0
370	                    ? "No files needed copying." : "Copied \(copied) file\(copied == 1 ? "" : "s")"
371	                        + " (\(ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: bytes, countStyle: .file)))"
372	                        + " into the package.")
373	            if cancelled { parts.append("Stopped before the rest.") }
374	            if !failures.isEmpty {
375	                parts.append(
376	                    "\(failures.count) file\(failures.count == 1 ? "" : "s") could not be copied.")
377	            }
378	            if !missing.isEmpty {
379	                parts.append(
380	                    "\(missing.count) missing file\(missing.count == 1 ? "" : "s") "
381	                        + "\(missing.count == 1 ? "was" : "were") left alone — relink "
382	                        + missing.prefix(3).joined(separator: ", ")
383	                        + (missing.count > 3 ? ", …" : "") + ".")
384	            }
385	            if !missingCursors.isEmpty {
386	                let one = missingCursors.count == 1
387	                parts.append(
388	                    "\(missingCursors.count) cursor file\(one ? " was" : "s were") missing and "
389	                        + "left alone.")
390	            }
391	            return parts.joined(separator: " ")
392	        }
393	    }
394	
395	    enum ConsolidateError: LocalizedError {
396	        case untitled
397	        case noMedia
398	        case unwritable(URL, String)
399	
400	        var errorDescription: String? {
401	            switch self {
402	            case .untitled:
403	                return "Save the project first — Consolidate Media copies files into the "
404	                    + ".framejob package, and a project that has never been saved does not have "
405	                    + "one yet."
406	            case .noMedia:
407	                return "This project references no media files."
408	            case .unwritable(let url, let reason):
409	                return "“\(url.lastPathComponent)” could not be created: \(reason)"
410	            }
411	        }
412	    }
413	
414	    /// A cancel flag the sheet sets on the main thread and the copy loop
415	    /// reads on its own queue. An `NSLock` rather than a plain `Bool`
416	    /// because that is a data race, and rather than a queue hop because the
417	    /// loop has to ask between every file.
418	    final class CancelToken {
419	        private let lock = NSLock()
420	        private var flag = false
421	
422	        var isCancelled: Bool {
423	            lock.lock()
424	            defer { lock.unlock() }
425	            return flag
426	        }
427	
428	        func cancel() {
429	            lock.lock()
430	            flag = true
431	            lock.unlock()
432	        }
433	    }
434	
435	    // MARK: - Planning
436	
437	    /// Everything the run will do, decided on the main thread against the
438	    /// document's current snapshot — so the copy loop, which runs on another
439	    /// queue, never reads the model.
440	    static func plan(for document: ProjectDocument) throws -> Plan {
441	        guard let directory = document.mediaDirectory else { throw ConsolidateError.untitled }
442	        let media = document.project.snapshot.media
443	        guard !media.isEmpty else { throw ConsolidateError.noMedia }
444	
445	        // Names already spoken for by an earlier consolidate. Lower-cased
446	        // because the volume under a package is usually case-insensitive,
447	        // and "Intro.mov" landing on "intro.mov" would be a lost file.
448	        var claimed = Set(
449	            ((try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path)) ?? [])
450	                .map { $0.lowercased() })
451	        // Two media entries can resolve to ONE file (different rows, the
452	        // same footage). The first row earns the copy; the rest are relinked
453	        // at it, so the package holds the footage once.
454	        var bySource: [String: URL] = [:]
455	
456	        var copies: [Copy] = []
457	        var relinks: [Copy] = []
458	        var aliases: [Copy] = []
459	        var missing: [String] = []
460	        var bytes: Int64 = 0
461	        var cursors = CursorPlan()
462	        for entry in media {
463	            guard let url = mediaURL(for: entry)?.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardizedFileURL
464	            else {
465	                missing.append(entry.name)
466	                continue
467	            }
468	            // Where the movie will be once the run is done, and the copy that
469	            // must land first for its cursor file (CU-51).
470	            let movieAt: URL
471	            let movieCopy: URL?
472	            if isInside(url, directory) {
473	                movieAt = url
474	                movieCopy = nil
475	                // Already consolidated. It still needs an op when a stale
476	                // bookmark or a differently-spelled path could send
477	                // `mediaURL(for:)` back outside the package.
478	                if entry.bookmark != nil || entry.path != url.path {
479	                    relinks.append(
480	                        Copy(
481	                            media: entry.id, name: url.lastPathComponent, source: url,
482	                            destination: url, bytes: 0))
483	                }
484	            } else if let shared = bySource[url.path] {
485	                movieAt = shared
486	                movieCopy = shared
487	                aliases.append(
488	                    Copy(
489	                        media: entry.id, name: shared.lastPathComponent, source: url,
490	                        destination: shared, bytes: 0))
491	            } else {
492	                let destination = directory.appendingPathComponent(
493	                    uniqueName(for: url, claimed: &claimed))
494	                bySource[url.path] = destination
495	                let size = fileSize(url)
496	                bytes += size
497	                copies.append(
498	                    Copy(
499	                        media: entry.id, name: destination.lastPathComponent, source: url,
500	                        destination: destination, bytes: size))
501	                movieAt = destination
502	                movieCopy = destination
503	            }
504	            bytes += planCursor(
505	                entry, movieAt: movieAt, movieCopy: movieCopy, directory: directory,
506	                claimed: &claimed, into: &cursors)
507	        }
508	        return Plan(
509	            directory: directory, copies: copies, relinks: relinks, aliases: aliases,
510	            missing: missing, bytes: bytes, cursorCopies: cursors.copies,
511	            cursorRelinks: cursors.relinks, cursorAliases: cursors.aliases,
512	            missingCursors: cursors.missing)
513	    }
514	
515	    /// The cursor lists as `plan` builds them, and the copies by resolved
516	    /// source path, so two media naming one file share one copy.
517	    private struct CursorPlan {
518	        var copies: [CursorCopy] = []
519	        var relinks: [CursorCopy] = []
520	        var aliases: [CursorCopy] = []
521	        var missing: [String] = []
522	        var bySource: [String: URL] = [:]
523	    }
524	
525	    /// Plans `entry`'s cursor file, if it has one, after its movie (CU-51):
526	    /// a file that resolves to nothing is missing; one already inside
527	    /// `media/` is relinked only when its bookmark or spelling could lead
528	    /// out; one another media's cursor already copies is an alias; anything
529	    /// else is a copy named `<the movie's stem>.fjcursor` by the claimed-name
530	    /// rule. Answers the bytes it adds to the plan.
531	    private static func planCursor(
532	        _ entry: MediaSnapshot, movieAt: URL, movieCopy: URL?, directory: URL,
533	        claimed: inout Set<String>, into cursors: inout CursorPlan
534	    ) -> Int64 {
535	        guard let cursor = entry.cursor, let file = cursorURL(for: entry) else { return 0 }
536	        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: file.path) else {
537	            cursors.missing.append(file.lastPathComponent)
538	            return 0
539	        }
540	        let url = file.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardizedFileURL
541	        if isInside(url, directory) {
542	            if cursor.bookmark != nil || cursor.path != url.path {
543	                cursors.relinks.append(
544	                    CursorCopy(
545	                        media: entry.id, name: url.lastPathComponent, source: url,
546	                        destination: url, bytes: 0, inPicture: cursor.inPicture, movie: nil))
547	            }
548	            return 0
549	        }
550	        if let shared = cursors.bySource[url.path] {
551	            cursors.aliases.append(
552	                CursorCopy(
553	                    media: entry.id, name: shared.lastPathComponent, source: url,
554	                    destination: shared, bytes: 0, inPicture: cursor.inPicture, movie: movieCopy))
555	            return 0
556	        }
557	        let named = CursorFileWriter.url(forMovie: movieAt)
558	        let destination = directory.appendingPathComponent(
559	            uniqueName(for: named, claimed: &claimed))
560	        cursors.bySource[url.path] = destination
561	        let size = fileSize(url)
562	        cursors.copies.append(
563	            CursorCopy(
564	                media: entry.id, name: destination.lastPathComponent, source: url,
565	                destination: destination, bytes: size, inPicture: cursor.inPicture,
566	                movie: movieCopy))
567	        return size
568	    }
569	
570	    private static func fileSize(_ url: URL) -> Int64 {
571	        Int64((try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.fileSizeKey]))?.fileSize ?? 0)
572	    }
573	
574	    /// Whether `url` already lives in the package's `media/` directory —
575	    /// both sides standardized, so `/tmp` and `/private/tmp` spellings of
576	    /// the same path agree.
577	    private static func isInside(_ url: URL, _ directory: URL) -> Bool {
578	        let root = directory.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardizedFileURL.path
579	        return url.path.hasPrefix(root.hasSuffix("/") ? root : root + "/")
580	    }
581	
582	    /// A file name nothing else in the directory has taken. Path separators
583	    /// cannot appear in a `lastPathComponent`, but a colon can (it is a
584	    /// separator in the Finder's own spelling), so it goes too.
585	    private static func uniqueName(for source: URL, claimed: inout Set<String>) -> String {
586	        let raw = source.lastPathComponent.replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "-")
587	            .replacingOccurrences(of: ":", with: "-")
588	        let base = raw.isEmpty ? "media" : raw
589	        let stem = (base as NSString).deletingPathExtension
590	        let ext = (base as NSString).pathExtension
591	        var candidate = base
592	        var suffix = 2
593	        while claimed.contains(candidate.lowercased()) {
594	            let root = stem.isEmpty ? "media" : stem
595	            candidate = ext.isEmpty ? "\(root)-\(suffix)" : "\(root)-\(suffix).\(ext)"
596	            suffix += 1
597	        }
598	        claimed.insert(candidate.lowercased())
599	        return candidate
600	    }

604	    /// Copies the planned files and returns the ops that record where they
605	    /// went. **Blocking** — the UI path calls it on a background queue with
606	    /// a progress sheet up (the one `DispatchQueue` seam this feature adds),
607	    /// the agent calls it inline.
608	    ///
609	    /// `progress` is called with a 0…1 fraction and the file being copied,
610	    /// on whatever thread this runs on; the sheet hops to main itself.
611	    ///
612	    /// An op is emitted only for a file that is really on disk, which is the
613	    /// whole of the "a failure part-way through leaves the project openable"
614	    /// promise.
615	    static func run(
616	        _ plan: Plan, cancel: CancelToken? = nil,
617	        progress: ((Double, String) -> Void)? = nil
618	    ) -> Outcome {
619	        var ops: [ReelOp] = []
620	        var failures: [String] = []
621	        var copied = 0
622	        var written: Int64 = 0
623	
624	        // The entries whose file is already inside cost nothing and go
625	        // first, so even a cancelled run leaves the package tidier.
626	        for entry in plan.relinks {
627	            ops.append(.relinkMedia(media: entry.media, path: entry.destination.path))
628	        }
629	        for entry in plan.cursorRelinks {
630	            ops.append(cursorOp(entry))
631	        }
632	
633	        let manager = FileManager.default
634	        do {
635	            try manager.createDirectory(at: plan.directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
636	        } catch {
637	            return Outcome(
638	                ops: ops, copied: 0, bytes: 0, missing: plan.missing,
639	                failures: [plan.directory.lastPathComponent + " — " + error.localizedDescription],
640	                cancelled: false, missingCursors: plan.missingCursors)
641	        }
642	
643	        var cancelled = false
644	        // The movie copies that really landed, which a cursor copy waits on.
645	        var landed = Set<String>()
646	        for entry in plan.copies {
647	            if cancel?.isCancelled == true {
648	                cancelled = true
649	                break
650	            }
651	            progress?(plan.bytes > 0 ? Double(written) / Double(plan.bytes) : 0, entry.name)
652	            do {
653	                // A destination left behind by an interrupted run holds a
654	                // half-written file AND its name; removing it first is what
655	                // makes a second Consolidate finish the job instead of
656	                // making a duplicate beside the stub.
657	                if manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path) {
658	                    try manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
659	                }
660	                try manager.copyItem(at: entry.source, to: entry.destination)
661	                ops.append(.relinkMedia(media: entry.media, path: entry.destination.path))
662	                landed.insert(entry.destination.path)
663	                copied += 1
664	                written += entry.bytes
665	            } catch {
666	                failures.append(entry.name + " — " + error.localizedDescription)
667	                try? manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
668	            }
669	        }
670	        // An alias points at another row's copy, so it may only be recorded
671	        // once that copy is really on disk — a failed or skipped copy leaves
672	        // both rows pointing at the original file, which still opens.
673	        for entry in plan.aliases where manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path) {
674	            ops.append(.relinkMedia(media: entry.media, path: entry.destination.path))
675	        }
676	        // The cursor files, each after its movie (CU-51): copied only once
677	        // that movie's copy landed, recorded only once its own copy did.
678	        for entry in plan.cursorCopies where !cancelled {
679	            if cancel?.isCancelled == true {
680	                cancelled = true
681	                break
682	            }
683	            guard entry.movie.map({ landed.contains($0.path) }) ?? true else { continue }
684	            progress?(plan.bytes > 0 ? Double(written) / Double(plan.bytes) : 0, entry.name)
685	            do {
686	                if manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path) {
687	                    try manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
688	                }
689	                try manager.copyItem(at: entry.source, to: entry.destination)
690	                ops.append(cursorOp(entry))
691	                copied += 1
692	                written += entry.bytes
693	            } catch {
694	                failures.append(entry.name + " — " + error.localizedDescription)
695	                try? manager.removeItem(at: entry.destination)
696	            }
697	        }
698	        for entry in plan.cursorAliases
699	        where manager.fileExists(atPath: entry.destination.path)
700	            && (entry.movie.map({ landed.contains($0.path) }) ?? true)
701	        {
702	            ops.append(cursorOp(entry))
703	        }
704	        progress?(1, "")
705	        return Outcome(
706	            ops: ops, copied: copied, bytes: written, missing: plan.missing, failures: failures,
707	            cancelled: cancelled, missingCursors: plan.missingCursors)
708	    }
709	
710	    /// `set_media_cursor` at the copy, with no bookmark: a bookmark to a file
711	    /// inside the package is one a later save may replace.
712	    private static func cursorOp(_ entry: CursorCopy) -> ReelOp {
713	        .setMediaCursor(
714	            media: entry.media,
715	            cursor: MediaCursor(path: entry.destination.path, inPicture: entry.inPicture))
716	    }
717	}

get_project "dict_keys(['project'])"
The whole project as JSON: canvas (width, height, fps [num, den], background, fit_new_clips, timecode_frames), media, tracks, clips and markers, with next_id — the schema every op edits. Plus the state that is deliberately NOT in the model and lives only in the app: playhead, selection and the in/out range. Read this first: every other tool names things by the ids it reports, and clip, track, marker and media ids share ONE number space, so an id is unambiguous on its own. tracks[0] is the BACK of the layer stack (the bottom lane of the timeline); times are ticks at 600000 per second. missing_media lists media whose file has moved — relink_media points it at the new one. graphics: every modul

set_selection "dict_keys(['clips', 'project'])"
Selects clips — clicking one in the timeline or on the canvas, and Edit ▸ Select All (⌘A). View state like the playhead and the range: nothing is undoable and the project is untouched. It matters because the canvas handles, crop mode and every inspector pane act on the SELECTION, so this is how you put the app into the state a screenshot should show. Call it with no clips (or []) to select nothing; get_project reports the result as selection. Note that the ops themselves take their own clips argument — selecting is not a prerequisite for editing.

insert_clip "dict_keys(['project', 'at', 'scope', 'track', 'media'])"
The INSERT edit — Edit ▸ Insert at Playhead, or ⌥-dropping a Media-tab row. Makes room for the whole media at `at`: the clip `at` is inside on `track` is split first, then every unlocked track opens by the media's length, then the media lands in the hole. Only the destination track is cut — a clip straddling `at` on another track rides the shift whole, which is what keeps a music bed unbroken — but for a cut clip's linked partner on an unlocked track, which is cut at `at` too and paired with it. One undo step.

overwrite_clip "dict_keys(['scope', 'media', 'at', 'track', 'project'])"
The OVERWRITE edit — Edit ▸ Overwrite at Playhead, or ⇧⌥-dropping a Media-tab row. Takes the room instead of making it: the span the media needs is cleared on `track` ALONE — cut at both bounds, whatever is left inside removed — and nothing shifts, so the cut's length and every other track are untouched, but for a cut clip's linked partner on an unlocked track, which is cut at the same bounds and paired; the partner's middle piece stays, unlinked. One undo step.

consolidate_media "dict_keys(['project'])"
Copies every file the project references into media/ inside the .framejob package and relinks the project at the copies — File ▸ Consolidate Media…. Afterwards the package is the whole edit: it can be moved or archived and still open with its original footage deleted. The project must have been saved (call save_project with a path first); files that are already inside are left alone, missing files are reported rather than guessed at, and a file that cannot be copied leaves its media entry pointing at the original, so the project always still opens. This can take a while and copies as many bytes as the footage weighs.

relink_media "dict_keys(['bookmark', 'path', 'media', 'project', 'scope'])"
Points a media entry at a file that moved — the Relink… sheet. The host probes the new file as import_media does, and the entry takes that file's duration, size, frame rate and audio/video/alpha flags. A file of another kind (audio for a video entry, say) is refused. A clip that runs past the end of a shorter file is shortened to end with it. A bookmark for the new location is stored so the next move is followed automatically. A WebM or Matroska file is copied into a .mov first and recorded as the entry's new original (the result's original), and a file the opt-in ffmpeg step converts is recorded the same way; any other file clears it. A relink also clears the entry's cursor file (media.curs

remove_media "dict_keys(['scope', 'project', 'media', 'with_clips'])"
Removes a media entry from the project. Media still used by clips is refused unless with_clips, which removes those clips (a LUT's: clears their looks).

content.content:
## Missing media and Relink

A project always opens, even when files it uses have moved or been deleted. Clips whose file is gone keep their place on the timeline and show a slate in their place, and their media rows wear the **missing** badge.

When a project opens with files missing, Frame Job offers the **Missing media** sheet once: "The project opened without these files: their clips keep their place on the timeline and show a slate until the files are found." Each missing file is listed with its old path and a **Locate…** button.

- Choosing a file for one entry also looks in that file's folder for the other missing files by name, and fills in each one it finds. A shoot moved as one folder is usually found with one Locate….
- A located row's button turns into **Change…**.
- The footnote counts the missing files ("3 files").
- **Relink** stays off until at least one file is located, then applies every choice as one undo step ("Relink Media"). You do not have to locate them all: the ones you skip stay missing, and you can relink them later from the Media tab. **Cancel** changes nothing.
- The sheet is offered once, when the window opens, and not over another sheet that is already showing.

Relinking checks the new file as an import does. The media takes the new file's duration, size, frame rate and audio/video flags. A clip that runs past the end of a shorter new file is shortened to end with it. A file of another kind (a sound file for a video entry, say) is refused, and the reason is shown after the other relinks are applied. A WebM or MKV chosen as the new file is copied as on import.

To relink one file at any time, use **Relink…** on its Media-tab row: "Choose the file for "*name*"."

A consolidated package that has been moved or renamed finds its own copies again when it opens: any missing media whose file sits in the package's `media/` folder under the same name is pointed back at it, with no sheet. A screen recording's cursor file is found again the same way.

*Agents:* `relink_media` (takes `media` and `path`; the app checks the new file itself). `get_project`'s `missing_media` lists what needs it.

## Consolidate Media

**File ▸ Consolidate Media…**, or **Consolidate…** at the foot of the Media tab, copies every file in the project's media list (used on the timeline or not) into the package's `media/` folder and points the project at the copies. Afterwards the package is the whole edit: you can hand it to someone, move it, or archive it and delete the originals.

- The project must have been saved first. On an untitled project the command asks "Save this project first?" and offers **Save…**; after the save it carries on.
- A **Consolidating Media** sheet shows progress ("Copying 4 files (2.1 GB) into the package…") and the file being copied. **Cancel** stops the copying; what was copied stays copied and the rest keep pointing at the originals, so the project always opens.
- When it finishes the sheet says what happened ("Copied 4 files (2.1 GB) into the package.", plus any files that could not be copied and any missing files it left alone) and offers **Show in Finder** and **Close**. The relinks are one undo step, "Consolidate Media".
- Two files with the same name are kept apart (`intro.mov`, `intro-2.mov`). Two entries that point at the same file share one copy. Files already inside the package are not copied again.
- Missing files cannot be copied: relink them first. If there is nothing to do, it says "Nothing to consolidate." and why.
- LUTs are consolidated like footage.
- A screen recording's cursor file is copied too, next to its movie and named after it (`Recording.mov` and `Recording.fjcursor`), and counts as one of the files copied. It is copied only once its movie is, and the project points at the copy only once it is there: a cursor file that cannot be copied is listed with the files that could not be, and the recording keeps its original cursor file. A cursor file that is missing is left alone ("1 cursor file was missing and left alone.").

The command is off when the project has no media.

*Agents:* `consolidate_media` (needs a saved project; can take a while and copies as many bytes as the footage weighs).

## Limits

- Consolidate Media needs a saved project.
